title: The Asset of the DMZ
author: Isandro Okonkwo
blurb: Jude Okonkwo, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must extract a defector who may be the bait, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
